ar.tool.description: Discover BACnet/IP devices on the local network. Sends a Who-Is broadcast and returns I-Am responses as a JSON or text list.
ar.param.timeout.description: Who-Is response wait time in seconds.
ar.param.interface.description: Local IPv4 address to bind (e.g. '192.168.1.100'). If omitted, BAC0 auto-detects the local interface.
ar.param.limit.description: Maximum number of devices to return. 0 means unlimited.
ar.msg.summary: BACnet/IP discovery completed: {count} device(s) found in {ms} ms.
ar.err.bac0_install: BAC0 library could not be installed.
